Sure! Those numbers are already a pair of latitude/longitude coordinates:

| Latitude | Longitude |
|----------|-----------|
| 37.4224764 | –122.0842499 |

Those coordinates point to the **Googleplex** (Google’s headquarters) in Mountain View, California.

---

### How to verify / look up the address with the Google Geocoding API

If you want to confirm the coordinates or retrieve the human‑readable address, you can perform a *reverse geocoding* request.  
Below is an example of how you would do that using the Google Geocoding API (you’ll need a valid API key).

```http
GET https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json
    ?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499
    &key=YOUR_API_KEY
```

#### Sample JSON response (truncated)

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "address_components": [
        {"long_name":"1600","short_name":"1600","types":["street_number"]},
        {"long_name":"Amphitheatre Parkway","short_name":"Amphitheatre Pkwy","types":["route"]},
        {"long_name":"Mountain View","short_name":"Mountain View","types":["locality","political"]},
        {"long_name":"Santa Clara County","short_name":"Santa Clara County","types":["administrative_area_level_2","political"]},
        {"long_name":"California","short_name":"CA","types":["administrative_area_level_1","political"]},
        {"long_name":"United States","short_name":"US","types":["country","political"]},
        {"long_name":"94043","short_name":"94043","types":["postal_code"]}
      ],
      "formatted_address":"1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA",
      "geometry": {
        "location": {"lat":37.4224764,"lng":-122.0842499},
        "location_type":"ROOFTOP",
        "viewport": {...}
      },
      "place_id":"ChIJj61dQgK6j4AR4J7x5Z8YfXU",
      "types":["street_address"]
    }
  ],
  "status":"OK"
}
```

> **Tip:** If you’re just looking to confirm the coordinates, you can also paste them into Google Maps or any other mapping service; the map will zoom to the exact spot.

---

### Quick recap

- **Coordinates you supplied:** `37.4224764, -122.0842499`
- **Location:** Googleplex, Mountain View, CA, USA
- **Reverse geocoding endpoint:** `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY`

Feel free to replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your actual key and hit the URL. If you run into any issues or need help parsing the response, let me know!
